title: Youma

alternative_titles.en: Blood Reign: Curse of the Yoma

synopsis:
During the Warring States period, violence spread throughout Japan like wildfire—touching the lives of even the most innocent people. As blood was spilled and soaked into the earth, evil energy began to collect, creating an ideal environment for demons known as Youma.

Hikage is on a journey to find Marou, his missing childhood friend. While he contends with Youma that have been feeding on people's misery, Hikage also learns that Marou is connected to them in a way he never expected.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
